layout_dets.text: Abstract

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear structure segmentation is essential in domains

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as medical imaging, remote sensing, and materials

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: science. Existing methods often require extensive domain-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: specific training and lack generalization to novel domains.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To overcome these limitations, we propose the Segment Any-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thing Curve Model (SACM) — a universal framework for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: curvilinear structure segmentation built upon the pretrained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Segment Anything Model (SAM). SACM introduces a dual-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: level adapter architecture that enables both fine-grained

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: local adaptation and robust cross-domain generalization:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: block-level internal adapters refine local structural repre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sentations, while external adapters facilitate cross-domain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature alignment. Specifically, the internal adapters are

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: embedded within each Transformer block to locally adapt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and refine features for thin and intricate curvilinear pat-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: terns, while the external adapters operate across blocks to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: capture global, multi-layer contextual information and fa-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cilitate domain adaptation. Furthermore, SACM introduces

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: a feature fusion mechanism that aggregates multi-layer fea-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures from all external adapters via a feed-forward network

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module, and a dual-stage refnement process in the mask

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: decoder to enhance topology and connectivity. This design

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: enables prompt-free, data-efficient fine-tuning and achieves

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: robust cross-domain generalization when trained with only

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 18 annotated images. Extensive experiments across twelve

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diverse curvilinear datasets validate that SACM achieves

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: state-of-the-art performance. The code is available at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: https://github.com/kylechuuuuu/SACM.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 1. Introduction

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear structures, such as vascular networks, neural

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pathways, and road systems, form the essential skeletons of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: objects across a vast spectrum of scientific and engineering

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (b)Tyre

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (d)Vessel

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ization in extracting complex curvilinear structures, including wire

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: networks, tyre tread, remote sensing roads, and retinal vessels.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domains [17]. Their accurate and automated segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is not merely a technical task but a critical enabler for funda-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mental applications, from quantifying neuronal degradation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: in neurodegenerative diseases [5] and monitoring infras-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tructural integrity [39] to analyzing root system architec-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures for crop improvement [13]. However, the manual de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lineation of these intricate patterns is notoriously laborious

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and unscalable, creating a significant bottleneck that im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pedes large-scale quantitative analysis and the deployment

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of high-throughput systems. This underscores a compelling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and persistent need for automated segmentation methods

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that are not only precise but also robust and generalizable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across diverse real-world scenarios.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear Structure Segmentation (CSS) presents a

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formidable challenge rooted in a fundamental dichotomy:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the need to reconcile local, fine-grained feature fidelity with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: global, long-range topological coherence. On one hand,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: these structures are defined by subtle local characteristics,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: such as faint boundaries, heterogeneous intensity profiles,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and rapidly varying widths, which are often corrupted by

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: noise or occluded by surrounding tissues [25, 28]. This de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mands a model with high sensitivity to low-level details.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Corresponding author.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Figure 2. Structure of different SAM-based adapter mechanisms:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (a) ViT Block in SAM without adaptation, (b) Medical Image

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapter architecture with both block internal and external adapter.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: On the other hand, these structures are defined by their con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tinuity, elongation, and branching topology, necessitating

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the preservation of global structural connectivity across ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tended regions. Many established CSS methods, from clas-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sic filter-based approaches to modern deep convolutional

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: networks [15, 22, 43], often excel at one aspect at the ex-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: pense of another. They tend to produce fragmented seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ments in low-contrast regions or lose fine details, thereby

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: failing to maintain topological integrity. Furthermore, their

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: heavy reliance on large, domain-specific annotated datasets

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: severely limits their cross-domain generalization, as models

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained on retinal vessels, for example, typically fail to seg-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment satellite road imagery, hindering their practical utility.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The recent advent of large-scale foundation models, par-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ticularly the SAM [12], has marked a paradigm shift in com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: puter vision, demonstrating unprecedented zero-shot gen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: eralization capabilities. However, these models were pri-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: marily designed for generic object segmentation and har-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: bor intrinsic architectural biases that render them subopti-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mal for the unique geometric properties of curvilinear struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures. A direct application is fundamentally challenged:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (1) The prompting mechanism is ill-posed for CSS. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dense, tortuous, and interconnected nature of curvilinear

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: networks makes discrete point- or box-based prompting im-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: practical and inefficient for achieving complete segmenta-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tion. (2) Existing adaptation strategies are insufficient. Cur-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: rent fine-tuning or adapter-based methods [3, 4, 18, 24]

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: typically insert lightweight modules into the MLP layers

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the Transformer blocks (as shown in Fig. 2(b)). This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: single-level adaptation primarily refines block-level local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: features, while neglecting the global structural modeling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mechanism itself. Consequently, it fails to explicitly en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: hance the model's capacity for capturing long-range spatial

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: dependencies that are essential for maintaining the continu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ity of curved global structures. This architectural limitation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: restricts their ability to effectively model global topology

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and transfer structural knowledge across disparate domains.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: To address the limitations of adapting generic vision

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: foundation models for CSS, we propose SACM, a uni-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: versal framework built upon the pre-trained SAM. Fig. 1

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: demonstrates SACM's superior segmentation results across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: diverse domains. Our approach introduces a novel Dual-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Level Adapter (DLAda) architecture (as shown in Fig. 2(c)),

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: designed to enhance both fine-grained local adaptation and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: robust global context refinement. Complementing this, we

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: develop a Prompt-Free Adapter-Fusion Decoder (PFAF-D)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: that integrates multi-layer features and employs a dual-stage

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: refinement process to generate precise and topologically co-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: herent segmentation masks. This synergistic design forms

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: our contributions, which are summarized as follows:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We propose SACM, a universal, prompt-free framework

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: for curvilinear structure segmentation built on the pre-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: trained SAM, enabling direct mask prediction without

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: user prompts, requiring only a few-shot training set for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: fine-tuning, and robust cross-domain generalization.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • We introduce a dual-level adapter architecture compris-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing: (1) block-internal adapters in each Transformer MLP

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: path for fine-grained local feature tuning, and (2) block-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: external adapters between Transformer blocks for global,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-layer feature injection. (3) An Adapter Fusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: module aggregates multi-layer features from all external

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapters and injects them into the mask decoder to en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: able prompt-free segmentation. The decoder then em-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ploys a two-stage refinement process to enhance segmen-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tation accuracy and topological connectivity.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: • Extensive experiments demonstrate that SACM con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: sistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: twelve curvilinear datasets, achieving strong cross-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: domain generalization with only few-shot training data,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: highlighting its practical utility for data-scarce scenarios.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2. Related Work

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.1. Curvilinear Structure Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Curvilinear segmentation targets thin, elongated struc-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tures. U-Net [25] established the baseline; subsequent

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: CNN improvements include residual blocks [1], multi-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: scale aggregation [14], attention modules [27], and de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: formable or dilated convolutions [47]. However, CNNs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: often produce fragmented outputs and rely on costly post-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: processing. Recent architectures emphasize global context

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and long-range dependencies: hybrid Transformer designs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: (e.g., TSNet [46]), state-space models with edge enhance-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ment (MambaVesselNet [16]), semi-supervised Trans-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: former methods for low-data regimes (EXP-Net [26]), and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: context-distillation decoders (FCoDT-Net [42]).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.2. SAM-based Semantic Segmentation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Foundation models shifted segmentation toward prompt-

layout_dets.text: driven, general-purpose frameworks. The SAM [12] en-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ables zero-shot, promptable masks and has inspired three

layout_dets.text: adaptation paths: (1) domain transfer via fine-tuning or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adapters (SAM-Med2D [4], CWSAM [24]); (2) prompt

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and output refinement to improve boundary quality (HQ-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 2.3. Adapter-Based Fine-tuning

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adapters provide parameter-efficient adaptation by freez-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing most pretrained weights and training small modules [3,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 24, 37]. Originating in NLP [6, 8], adapters are effective

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across vision tasks [7, 34, 38] and help reduce memory

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: and compute during transfer [32, 44]. However, by insert-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ing adapters only locally within Transformer blocks, these

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: methods lack a mechanism for global, multi-scale feature

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: aggregation. This architectural limitation makes them in-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: herently unsuitable for curvilinear segmentation, which de-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mands long-range spatial dependency modeling to maintain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: topological continuity.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3. Methodology

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: This section provides a detailed description of SACM, our

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: prompt-free framework for CSS, built upon a frozen SAM

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: image encoder. SACM's architecture is centered around

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: two key components: (1) DLAda for both local and global

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature adaptation within the encoder, and (2) PFAF-D for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: multi-layer features fusion and dual-stage mask refinement.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The overall pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 3, with each com-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ponent elaborated in the subsequent subsections.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1. Dual-Level Adapter Architecture

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The DLAda architecture is the core component enabling

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: parameter-efficient fine-tuning and robust domain general-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ization for curvilinear structures. As demonstrated in Fig. 3,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: it is strategically integrated into every Transformer block

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: across the depth of the frozen SAM image encoder. This

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: design achieves feature adaptation across multiple granu-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: larities while effectively preserving the knowledge encoded

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: within the pretrained foundation model backbone. The

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: DLAda architecture comprises two distinct, yet comple-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: mentary, components that collaboratively address the chal-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: lenge of fine-grained local feature discrimination and global

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: topological coherence: the block-internal adapter (Adapter-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: I) and the block-external adapter (Adapter-E).

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 3.1.1. Block-Internal Adapter

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The block-internal adapter is designed for fine-grained local

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: feature adaptation within the transformer block, focusing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: on refining feature representations crucial for distinguishing

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: thin structures from the complex background. Following

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: established parameter-efficient fine-tuning methodologies,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Adapter-I is embedded within the residual pathway of the

layout_dets.text: 5. Conclusion

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: In this paper, we presented SACM, a prompt-free frame-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: work for curvilinear structure segmentation built on SAM.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: By improving both local detail and global structural con-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: tinuity, SACM achieves strong few-shot and cross-domain

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: performance. Experiments on twelve datasets show that

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: SACM consistently outperforms existing baselines using

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: only 18 training images. Future work will explore continual

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: adaptation, more efficient fine-tuning, and improved robust-

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: ness to severe domain shifts.
